fusions.name: Stiff-Legged Pounce
fusions.desc: Springs onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and rakes it for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Arched and Hissing
fusions.desc: Arches and hisses across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave each target [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hackles Up
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 15% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Soft Step, Sour Strike
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
